# Face fixtures for recognition tests (TEST ONLY)

These images are **not photographs of people**. They are deterministic
synthetic 112×112 BGR crops used as aligned-face inputs for SFace in
automated tests and the optional `RECOGNITION_TEST_MODE` harness.

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `synthetic_aligned_a.png` | Generated by `backend/scripts/generate_recognition_fixtures.py` (seed 8) | Project-created; no third-party content |
| `synthetic_aligned_b.png` | Generated by `backend/scripts/generate_recognition_fixtures.py` (seed 143) | Project-created; no third-party content |

SFace cosine between A and B is verified below `FACE_RECOGNITION_THRESHOLD` (0.363)
when regenerating against the project ONNX model.

Regenerate:

```powershell
backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\scripts\generate_recognition_fixtures.py
```

```bash
backend/.venv/bin/python backend/scripts/generate_recognition_fixtures.py
```

Do **not** use these fixtures for production enrollment or as biometric
identity evidence. They exist only so Known/Unknown/Event tests can run
without a USB webcam.
